model_scope: Partial registered-rental housing scenario; not all corridor housing or observed 505 demand.

22 124214 STE 13 OZ.note: Use the internally consistent May 2024 decision-report revision: 632 total minus 8 removed = 624 net. Pipeline snapshot says 630; preserve that conflict rather than combining revisions. Future site delivery is unobserved.

26 122451 STE 13 OZ.note: June 2026 report describes a sales centre and surface parking on the current site. Zero current homes is derived from that description, not the earlier whole Regent Park demolition programme.

25 236949 STE 13 OZ.note: Consultation confirms 1,197 proposed units but not the existing residential count. Zero existing homes remains an assumption requiring current application review, not a confirmed net-new total. Historical report downloads returned 404 and are not relied on.

westward_share.meaning: Share of generated commuters given a workplace west of home; the rest are placed anywhere else. Uncalibrated; employment locations alone do not establish commute direction.

walk_limit_m.meaning: Longest walk to work, to a useful Line 1 station or to/from a 505 stop. Walking distance is straight-line distance times the reviewed detour factor.

parallel_route_bands.unit: fraction of the distance from Dundas to College/Carlton (north) or Queen (south)
parallel_route_bands.meaning: Below the first value all commuters consider the 505; up to the second, half do; beyond it they are assumed to use the 506 or 501 and leave the model.

incoming_load_range.unit: passengers already aboard per car at Broadview & Dundas
incoming_load_range.meaning: Each car entering the segment draws its starting load uniformly from this range. No observed incoming occupancy exists; this is the input most likely to change who is left behind.

stop_dwell_range_s.meaning: Each stop's dwell is drawn uniformly from this range. Scheduled link times may already include some dwell, so this can double count.

entry_schedule_s.meaning: Dated GTFS entries for baseline service; an empty list selects an alternative regular timetable.

clearance_s.meaning: Optional later service for the measured cohort; zero preserves the original cutoff.

max_corridor_delay_s.meaning: Explicit operational assumption; not an observed service measure.

warmup_duration_s.meaning: Explicit operational assumption; not an observed service measure.
